verdicts.reason: A reads left to right in a sensible order (brand and headline on the left, date, pills and CTA in the middle, phone on the right) and keeps the hierarchy, but the middle column is cramped, the legal text is tiny and squeezed under the CTA, the phone is jammed against the right edge, and the missing-asset placeholder collides with the phone. B's reading order is broken: 'Solstice Presents' is detached far to the right, the tagline sits above the date, and the RSVP button is mixed in with the info pills so it reads as just another tag. A huge grey missing-asset box takes up the right third, the legal text floats with no anchor, and the right half is a mostly dead, unbalanced zone.
